title: Verification
description: Validates the Verifier output artifact for the Supervisor-CAO platform. A verification record captures whether the candidate passed both local (WSL) and remote (containerized) verification, the environment used, paths to evidence logs, and whether the result is stale. PUBLIC schema: sanitized, contains no secrets, hostnames, or private paths.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task being verified.

candidate_sha.description: Git SHA of the candidate commit submitted for verification.

tested_sha.description: Git SHA actually built and tested (may differ from candidate_sha if the verifier rebased or amended).

passed.description: Overall pass/fail verdict for the verification.

wsl_results.description: Results of the local WSL build and pytest run.

pytest_passed.description: Whether the local pytest run passed.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the local WSL run.

remote_results.description: Results of the remote containerized verification run.

container.description: Identifier of the container image used for the remote run.

install_ok.description: Whether the package installed successfully in the remote container.

correctness_passed.description: Whether the correctness test suite passed in the remote container.

asv_result.description: Optional ASV (airspeed velocity) benchmark result payload from the remote run.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the remote run.

environment.description: Description of the verification environment (toolchain, OS, arch, dependency versions).

logs.description: Paths to evidence log files produced during verification.

build_log.description: Path to the build log file.

pytest_log.description: Path to the pytest log file.

asv_log.description: Path to the ASV benchmark log file.

remote_log.description: Path to the remote container run log file.

exit_code.description: Authoritative exit code from the deterministic verification runner. The LLM cannot change this.

stale.description: Whether this verification result is stale (e.g. the baseline moved after the run). Defaults to false.
